title: Salesforce sets AI token budgets after some spent $1,000s per month
excerpt: Salesforce is capping employee AI token spending after some workers ran up thousands of dollars in monthly costs.
content_html:

Salesforce sets AI budgets after employees spent 'thousands of dollars per month on tokens,' memo says

By Ashley Stewart

You're currently following this author! Click to unsubscribe from email alerts.

2026-11-17T19:07:58.412Z

Salesforce is setting AI budgets for employees after some spent thousands per month on tokens last quarter, according to an internal memo viewed by Business Insider.

"Starting this month, every role has a monthly token budget, so we can focus our AI spend on the work that matters most for our customers and business," Salesforce Chief Operating Officer Miguel Milano wrote in an email to employees.

The budgets reflect a delicate balance for companies adopting AI. They want to control spending for the expensive technology without discouraging employees from using it.

A Salesforce spokesperson said the company does not have companywide individual token budgets, leaving it up to team leaders to manage AI usage. "Our focus is always to ensure that our AI investments deliver the greatest impact for our business and customers," the spokesperson added.

Salesforce piloted the new AI budgets on one team for a month and found that group "was operating well under budget by month two with no drop in output," the memo stated.

The sales organization under President and Chief Revenue Officer Alexa Vignone will have a budget of $1,000 per month for technical roles, and $100 per month for non-technical roles like sellers.

Salesforce Customer Success, under Jim Roth, and Salesforce Global Professional Services and Forward Deployed Engineering, under Lori Steele, will have budgets of $500 per month for technical roles and $100 per month for non-technical roles.

Other companies have introduced similar spending limits. As Business Insider recently reported, Coinbase has weekly AI spending caps ranging from $500 to $5,000 based on employee roles and seniority. JPMorgan Chase introduced a $2,000 monthly limit for some engineers using Anthropic's Claude Code.

In May, Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff said the company expected to spend roughly $300 million on Anthropic tokens this year, largely for coding agents.

Read the memo

Team,

As we scale our AI capabilities, we're getting smarter about how we manage them.

Last quarter, some individuals spent thousands of dollars per month on tokens.

With AI confidence now high, we're shifting focus from adoption to impact.

Starting this month, every role has a monthly token budget, so we can focus our AI spend on the work that matters most for our customers and business.

What's changing

Monthly Token Spend Limits by Role

Alexa's Org

  • Technical Roles: $1,000 per month
  • GTM/Seller Roles (Non-Technical): $100 per month

Jim & Lori's Orgs

  • Delivery Roles (Technical): $500 per month
  • GTM/Seller Roles (Non-Technical): $100 per month

Starting today, we are asking you to manage your own budget and leaders to coach directs to stay within their budget.

OU leaders will manage each of their team's budgets, similar to T&E, so one person's spike can be offset by others.

Starting next week, when an individual's Al spend is approaching 100%, the individual and the manager will both get a notification from the DevBar app in Slack, with the option to request advanced approval up to 20% above the individual limit.

When an individual's spend is approaching 100%, the individual and the manager will both get a Slack notification from the DevBar app, with the option to request advanced approval up to 20% above the individual limit.

If you or your team needs more budget, request exceptions.

Approval needs scale with the size of the ask:

  • Up to 20% above the individual limit, one-time request: the second line manager approves.
  • More than 20% above, up to 3x the individual limit: the third line manager approves, and you'll need to include an ROI justification. The increase lasts 90 days and is reviewed when it expires.
  • Above 3x the individual limit: Alexa, Jim, or Lori to approve, with finance. These are reviewed every month.

What I'm asking of you

  1. Track individual and team usage: AI Spend Dashboard*
  2. Review usage monthly: For leaders, if someone is over budget, ask what is driving it and whether less spend could get to the same result. Both individuals and leaders can request exceptions here. This Slack workflow is an interim solution while we build a more robust process. We never want a budget to get in the way of great work: if you have a high-impact use case that needs more, ask.
  3. Add the token consumption topic to your manager 1:1s: match the model to the task, and start with Slackbot and Gemini for drafting, summarizing, and research. Sellers, try Slack Surfaces or Claude Artifacts. Even heavy users typically spend <$100 per month.

More token budget management resources are coming soon. For now, go to the Al Tools Optimization canvas for DevBar setup, model-to-task guidance, and FAQs.

Why I'm confident: We piloted this in T&P, and after a hands-on first month, the team was operating well under budget by month two with no drop in output.

Thank you for helping us prioritize Al spend where it matters most.

Miguel

*Works Council countries will have visibility to pooled team spending. While leaders will not see direct individual employee usage, they should still work with the team on token management best practices.
